inputs.description: Per-kind input payload, written only by apply.py and never by a model. An `extract` task carries {url, title, domain}; a `verify` task carries {hypothesis, refutes}. Free-form because the writer is code: the scheduler raises if a kind's required keys are absent (scheduler.agent_input), which is a stronger check than a schema over data we generated ourselves.

queries.description: For a `search` task, the queries its searcher reported issuing. Written by apply_search after the fact, which is why it is a top-level field and not part of `inputs`: `inputs` is documented as the per-kind INPUT payload, and these are output. OPTIONAL -- this schema is additionalProperties: false, so requiring it would invalidate every task already on disk; absent means "written before this field existed, or not a search". abandoned_reason is the same shape for the same reason. Appendix E renders these.
